name: Kashiwabara Ryuuichi
source:
A talented engineer who works with corporate infrastructure and security. His hobbies include browsing the dark web and visiting concept cafes. He met the protagonist and Tomona through an investigation of a cult that was active on the internet. He is highly skilled in hacking, using his skills to constantly track the protagonist.

[From [url=https://tokyo-psychodemic.com/?lang=en]Official Website[/url]]
